blocks.text: An “absent” father is a common theme in a Filipino household. But can a father who provides financial support without physical presence still be considered an “absent” parent? “Buddy,” starring Michael de Mesa, explores this question. The film follows Jojo, played by de Mesa, a retired seaman who spent decades working at sea to provide for his family. Now a widower, he travels to Finland to reconnect with his three estranged children: Jake (EA Guzman), Abby (Elisse Joson) and Eli (Elijah Canlas), only to discover that years of physical distance have also created an emotional gap between them.
